title: The Frame Send

context.version: 0.6.11 (GitHub release, Feb 3 2025; no repo activity since Mar 2025)

captures.note: real send: 0.0002 ETH → austingriffith.eth via send.frame.eth
dry: stopped at Frame's sign screen

_comment: Frame, a desktop wallet, plain ETH send. Frame has no send form of its own: its tray button opens send.frame.eth, a dapp it resolves through ENS, fetches over IPFS from Frame's Nebula gateway and serves on 127.0.0.1:8421; signing happens in Frame's own window with a local hot signer. Every chain defaults to Frame's Pylon RPC (wss://evm.pylon.link). Fewest third parties of any wallet mapped: Frame Labs, CoinGecko images, GitHub updates. Frame's main process ignores the system proxy, so its websocket traffic (RPC, rates, inventory) is seen only as TLS to Pylon's IPs in the pcap; what it carries is read from source (floating/frame v0.6.11). Last release Feb 2025. Real mainnet tx 0x9b2302a63fadde94119b687b2fcfb2de16f582381d991caac4369d987ff57f0f.
